msg.fileProtocol:
The page is open directly from disk, so the browser blocks reading
assets/manifest.json and the JSON files themselves (file:// security rule).

Serve the folder over HTTP instead, then reload:

    python3 -m http.server 8000   # from the folder containing index.html
    open http://localhost:8000/
